listing.name: Doko Demo Issyo Portable — dokodemo-native (Senya01)
listing.summary: Build this incomplete Doko Demo Issyo port from source. Room, conversation and interface support is limited; starting a player session and continuing between rooms have not been confirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese v1.01 UCJS10002 game, including BOOT.BIN, audio and game resources. Setup also requires locally generated headers. FFmpeg is optional and supplied separately.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream Windows source-build instructions with Visual Studio, CMake and Ninja. Generate the external headers locally from your own BOOT.BIN and audio manifest. Supply the separate FFmpeg development package only if using that optional feature.

warnings: This incomplete game has limited room, conversation and interface paths. Starting a player session and continuing between rooms have not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
